sources.finding: Timer structs are serialized; dual arena arrays are conditional on mj_isDual(model). Absent arena payload pointers are null on deserialize.
Dual eligibility is solver == mjSOL_PGS or noslip_iterations > 0.
Getter builds an array from native field pointer, shape and owner; ownership metadata is inspected without copying unbacked contents.
Each timer contains cumulative duration and call count. Field names and timer indices are diagnostic statistics.

boundary: Source interpretation supports probe design; actual payload attribution and model eligibility require the registered readout.
